newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.

LIVE CATTLE - 0.20 to 0.25 cent higher. News of cash cattle in Texas trading at $64.00 per cwt, up $2.00 from late last week, should provide some support. Beef prices also continue to firm although there is some concern that movement is fairly light.

FEEDER CATTLE - steady to 0.25 cent higher. Weaker overnight CBOT corn prices should be supportive while the latest CME feeder cattle index was higher amid growing talk about a possible shortage of feeders this fall.

LEAN HOGS - steady to 0.10 cent higher. Product values continue to firm although cash hogs may be steady at best with some talk that packers may have managed to buy most of the hogs they needed on Tuesday.

PORK BELLIES - steady to up 0.25 cent. Strength in cash fresh belly market should be supportive. The CME's weekly out-of-town pork belly storage report, however, showed a slightly smaller drawdown in stocks than some had expected.
